delta.args_delta: {"reply":{"text":"Thank you for your question. The current knowledge base only contains information about controller heat and Flow strip flicker, and does not cover Wi‑Fi compatibility or bedroom suitability for the Lumen Glow E27. For details on Wi‑Fi bands and recommended usage environments, please refer to the product manual or the Lumen support website. If you need further assistance, let us know.","citations":[{"chunk_id":"kb_strip0flck","quote":"If a Flow strip flickers near the controller, cut the power and check the controller plug. If the flicker comes back, the controller is replaced under warranty."},{"chunk_id":"kb_ctrlheat01","quote":"If the controller body is hot to the touch, unplug the strip at once and do not switch it on until it has been checked."}]} }
